response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer, but the profile does not match the mandatory requirements of this role. Professional C++ work is limited to roughly seven months at National Instruments in 2014–2015; the last decade has been almost entirely JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang. There is no Windows-platform C++ track record, no SQL Server or Oracle depth (SQL is listed generically alongside MongoDB/MySQL), and no fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain exposure — RIDE Capital is fintech/investment adjacent but not capital-markets systems work. Strong fundamentals, testing culture, and communication skills are evident, but the gap to the hard requirements is too large for a mid-senior consulting engagement on critical trading-adjacent systems.
strengths: Deep low-latency/systems experience (DLang, async I/O, high-throughput services)
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, DevOps, open-source tooling
Excellent communication evidenced by talks, workshops, and course authoring
concerns: Only ~7 months of professional C++, over a decade ago
No Windows platform C++ or SQL Server/Oracle experience
No fixed income, derivatives, or capital-markets domain background
